Domain Battlegroup XVI is a branch of the Domain Military with the mission of the research and development of advanced technologies, before the collapse the Battlegroup answered directly to a figure within the Domain military structure known as Arbitrator Zero and worked closely with the various Scientific Research Institutes of the Domain. The Battlegroup was on a routine tech mining expedition on the moon of Malkuth in the Nagazora Star System when the Collapse occured, trapping the battlegroup in the frindges of the Persean Sector.
